find_restrooms_nearby.description: Find the safe restrooms closest to a latitude and longitude, nearest first, each with how far away it is and in which direction. Filter for ADA accessible, unisex, or a changing table, and set a walking radius. REFUGE Restrooms searches 20 miles around the point and no further, so a rural search can come back empty. No API key required.

nearest.name: The SF LGBT Center

parameters.description: The latitude to search around, in decimal degrees. Pair it with a longitude from the same source: a phone's location, a geocoded address, or an earlier step.
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: The longitude to search around, in decimal degrees. Negative west of Greenwich.
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: Optional. Only return restrooms marked ADA accessible. Off by default. Turning it off does not mean 'only ones that are not accessible': it means no filter at all, which is all REFUGE Restrooms offers.
parameters.name: accessible_only

parameters.description: Optional. Only return restrooms that are unisex, all-gender or single-occupancy. Off by default. As with Accessible only, turning it off applies no filter rather than reversing it.
parameters.name: unisex_only

parameters.description: Optional. Only return restrooms with a baby changing table. Off by default. REFUGE Restrooms cannot filter on this itself, so this step reads through the radius and filters the whole set rather than one page of it.
parameters.name: changing_table_only

parameters.description: Optional. Only return restrooms within this many miles of the point. Leave blank for everything REFUGE Restrooms has within its fixed 20-mile radius. Use it for 'somewhere I can walk to'.
parameters.name: max_distance_miles

parameters.description: Optional. How many restrooms to return. Between 1 and 100; 10 by default. REFUGE Restrooms refuses a larger page.
parameters.name: limit

count.description: How many restrooms came back in this result.

has_restrooms.description: True when anything matched. Branch on this rather than on the list being empty.

latitude.description: The latitude that was searched from.

longitude.description: The longitude that was searched from.

max_distance_miles.description: The distance limit that was applied, in miles. Null when there was none.

nearest.description: The closest matching restroom, lifted out of the list so a message can use it without indexing. Null when nothing matched.

accessible.description: True when the listing is marked ADA accessible. This is the field the 'Accessible only' filter searches on.

approved.description: True for every restroom the API returns: unapproved submissions and pending edits are never served.

changing_table.description: True when the restroom has a baby changing table. REFUGE Restrooms cannot filter on this itself, so 'Find restrooms nearby' does the filtering for you.

comment.description: Anything else the contributor wanted to say about the restroom, e.g. that it needs a key from the counter. Null when there is none.

country.description: Country, usually a two-letter code such as 'US'. Listings added by hand sometimes spell the country out instead.

created_at.description: When the listing was added, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

created_date.description: The date the listing was added, YYYY-MM-DD.

direction.description: Which way the restroom lies from the point that was searched, as a compass name such as 'northeast'.

downvote.description: How many people have voted it down.

summarize_restrooms_nearby.description: Count the safe restrooms around a latitude and longitude and break them down: how many are ADA accessible, how many unisex, how many have a changing table, and which is nearest of each. Returns numbers rather than a list, so it is the cheap way to answer 'is this area covered?' before deciding whether to list anything. No API key required.

description: Find safe, accessible restrooms from REFUGE Restrooms, the volunteer-built directory of gender-neutral and ADA accessible restrooms used by transgender, intersex and gender-nonconforming people worldwide. Search around a set of coordinates and get the nearest ones with the distance and direction to each, filter for accessible, unisex or a changing table, or search the whole directory by place name, city or a word from a listing's directions. Summarize how well an area is covered before a trip, and watch for listings added or corrected since a date. Every listing comes back with its directions, comments, community votes and a map link. No account or API key required.
